label: register-single-task
description: Register a tasklist with a single task and complete it

input.task: Register a tasklist 'onboarding' with a single task 'welcome' labeled 'Welcome user'. Start and finish it, then inspect.

label: register-two-tasks-sequential
description: Register two sequential tasks and complete both

input.task: Register a tasklist 'setup' with tasks 'init' (label: 'Initialize') and 'configure' (label: 'Configure'). Complete both sequentially, then inspect.

label: start-before-finish
description: Start a task, do work, then finish it

input.task: Register tasklist 'processing' with task 'fetch' (label: 'Fetch data'). Start the task, assign fetched data, finish the task, then inspect.

label: three-tasks-linear
description: Complete three tasks in a simple linear chain

input.task: Register tasklist 'pipeline' with tasks: 'load' (label: 'Load data'), 'transform' (label: 'Transform'), 'export' (label: 'Export'). Complete all three in order, then inspect.

label: inspect-tasklist-status
description: Check task statuses after completion

input.task: Register tasklist 'audit' with tasks 'scan' and 'report'. Complete them and call status() on each. Inspect with the results.

label: dag-deps-basic
description: Task B depends on A; start B only after A is done

input.task: Register tasklist 'build' with tasks: 'compile' (label: 'Compile', no deps) and 'link' (label: 'Link', deps: ['compile']). Complete compile first, then link. Inspect.

label: dag-diamond
description: Diamond dependency: A→B, A→C, B+C→D

input.task: Register tasklist 'diamond' with: A (no deps), B (deps: [A]), C (deps: [A]), D (deps: [B, C]). Complete in valid topological order. Inspect.

label: dag-multi-step-pipeline
description: 5-step pipeline with strict deps

input.task: Register tasklist 'etl' with: fetch (no deps), validate (deps: fetch), clean (deps: validate), aggregate (deps: clean), report (deps: aggregate). Complete all steps in order. Inspect.

label: dag-parallel-then-merge
description: Two parallel tasks that merge into one

input.task: Register tasklist 'parallel' with: fetchA (no deps), fetchB (no deps), merge (deps: [fetchA, fetchB]). Complete both fetches, then merge. Inspect.

label: dag-skip-unblocks-dep
description: Skipping a task unblocks its dependents

input.task: Register tasklist 'optional-step' with: prefetch (no deps), process (deps: [prefetch]). Skip prefetch, then start process (deps should be satisfied). Inspect.

label: optional-fail-unblocks
description: optional:true fail unblocks dependents

input.task: Register tasklist 'resilient' with: probe (label: 'Probe', optional: true) and analyze (label: 'Analyze', deps: [probe]). Start probe, fail it (optional), then start and finish analyze. Inspect.

label: optional-true-pattern
description: Model correctly uses optional:true for non-critical steps

input.task: Register tasklist 'scraper' with: warmup (label: 'Cache warmup', optional: true), scrape (label: 'Scrape', deps: [warmup]), parse (label: 'Parse', deps: [scrape]). Fail warmup (optional), then complete scrape and parse. Inspect.

label: optional-fail-multiple-deps
description: Mix of optional and required deps

input.task: Register tasklist 'mixed-deps' with: required-step (label: 'Required', optional: false), optional-step (label: 'Optional', optional: true), final (label: 'Final', deps: [required-step, optional-step]). Complete required-step. Fail optional-step (optional). Start final. Inspect.

label: getAll-returns-records
description: getAll() returns all task records

input.task: Register tasklist 'summary' with three tasks. Complete two of them. Call getAll() and inspect the result.

label: nudge-while-in-progress
description: nudge() returns summary when tasks are unfinished

input.task: Register tasklist 'long-job' with tasks: prep (no deps), execute (deps: [prep]), finalize (deps: [execute]). Start and finish prep, start execute. Call nudge() and inspect its return value.

label: condition-skip-auto
description: condition expression falsy → auto-skip on start()

input.task: Register tasklist 'conditional-flow' with task 'optional-fetch' (label: 'Optional fetch', condition: 'false'). Call start('optional-fetch') — it should auto-skip. Inspect the status.

label: condition-truthy-runs
description: condition expression truthy → task runs normally

input.task: Register tasklist 'cond-run' with task 'main' (label: 'Main task', condition: 'true'). Start main — it should go in_progress. Finish it. Inspect.

label: outputSchema-finish-validation
description: finish() with value validated against outputSchema

input.task: Register tasklist 'validated' with task 'fetch-user' (label: 'Fetch user', outputSchema: { type: 'object', required: ['id', 'name'], properties: { id: { type: 'number' }, name: { type: 'string' } } }). Start the task. Fetch a user object { id: 1, name: 'Alice' }. Finish with the value. Inspect.

label: complex-dag-with-conditions
description: DAG with conditions and optional tasks

input.task: Register tasklist 'smart-pipeline' with: preflight (label: 'Preflight check', condition: 'true'), load (label: 'Load', deps: [preflight]), transform (label: 'Transform', deps: [load], optional: true), export (label: 'Export', deps: [transform]). Complete the pipeline: preflight, load, transform, export. Inspect at end.

label: full-workflow-with-nudge
description: Complete multi-phase workflow using nudge for progress tracking

input.task: Register tasklist 'full-workflow' with: research (label: 'Research'), draft (label: 'Draft', deps: [research]), review (label: 'Review', deps: [draft]), publish (label: 'Publish', deps: [review]). Complete research and draft. Check nudge() to see remaining tasks. Finish review and publish. Inspect.
